# v1.6.0 Release Notes — Public Bot Apps, Unified Global Storage & Real-Time Feeds

![bot-team v1.6.0 Milestone Release Cover — Public Bot Apps, Unified Global Storage & Real-Time Feeds](./artifact/bot-team-v160-release-cover.png)

**`bot-team v1.6.0`** expands workspace Bot Apps onto the open web, unifies host-level data persistence, overhauls live Feeds wire efficiency and recovery speed, and brings streaming UI primitives and native iOS motion polish across Desktop Electron, Cloud Web, Mobile Safari, and iOS Home-Screen PWAs (`47e9581..a71bc61` in `bot-team` and `b544891..e3099b0` in `bot-team-services` — **28 `bot-team` commits and 7 Cloud Gateway commits across 33 tracked issues**). Operators and agents can now publish any Bot App to a **Claude Artifact-style isolated Railway Public Host (`bot-team-public-apps`)** with standalone web/backend execution and an optional **unified 6-digit invite-code PIN gate** (`#F-648`), store Feeds and Issues cleanly inside **unified global `~/.bot-team/` storage** with full `./.bot-team/` compatibility and `core.sock` delegation (`#F-645`), stream live Feeds over **`~1 KB` SSE deltas (`>1,000×` smaller)** with **`5–8 ms` zero-refresh delivery and `17–20 ms` severed-connection wake recovery** (`#F-627`, `#F-646`), render **streaming `remend` Markdown, `StackTraceCard`, Fork `Checkpoint` rulers, and safe inline ```` ```sdui ```` micro-cards** (`#F-643`), and navigate Mobile with **native iOS spring push/sheet choreography** (`#F-638`) — all with **zero edits** to the frozen 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` runtime closure (`ADR 0012`, `daemon-boundary.mjs` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).

```mermaid
    Gateway["Railway Cloud Gateway (15s Named SSE Ping · Live warmSnapshots Eviction · Phase-2 Reset Guards)"]
    Core["Tier-2 CoreServer (1 KB FeedSnapshotDelta SSE · beforeSeq Pagination · issue.* core.sock Delegation)"]
    Vault["Unified Storage Layer (Global ~/.bot-team/ Vault + Project ./.bot-team/ Read Compatibility + Dynamic Brand Config)"]
    Apps["Tier-3 AppsDaemon v2 (Instant L3 Wake Fix · 13-Block BotAppSduiBlock Schema · Public Host Deployer)"]
    PublicHost["Isolated Railway Project: bot-team-public-apps (Standalone Web + API Runtime · Optional Unified 6-Digit PIN Gate)"]
    Daemon["Tier-1 AgentDaemon (Frozen 20-File Runtime Closure · 0 Edits · daemonOutdated = false)"]

    Clients <-->|"~1 KB SSE Deltas (5-8ms Live / 17-20ms Wake)"| Gateway
    Clients <-->|"Local IPC / LAN & Cloud Mux"| Core
    Gateway <-->|"Compacted Feeds + resyncRequired Fallback"| Core
    Core <-->|"Freshness-Guarded Atomic R/W"| Vault
    Core <-->|"Host Bridge v2 & Public Publish RPCs"| Apps

```


## 1. Claude Artifact-Style Public Host for Bot Apps & Instant L3 Wake (`#F-648`, `#F-647` · `BOT-553`–`BOT-557`)

Workspace Bot Apps can now be shared externally with teammates, stakeholders, or customers in one click without exposing the private host daemon, workspace filesystem, or Cloud Gateway credentials:

- **Isolated `bot-team-public-apps` Railway Project & Standalone Runtime (`BOT-554`, `194ba86`)**: provisions a dedicated, security-isolated Railway project (`bot-team-public-apps`) completely separate from `cloud-gateway`. Published apps run inside a pure standalone web + `/api/*` container wrapper (`/__public_health`, strict CSP/security headers, and sanitized environment variables verified with `leakedSensitiveEnv: []`).
- **`AppsDaemon` Public Host RPCs & `bot-team app public` CLI (`BOT-555`, `79ac255`)**: wires `apps.public.publish`, `apps.public.unpublish`, `apps.public.status`, and `apps.public.config` across Tier-3 `AppsDaemon`, shared contracts, and `bot-team app public <publish|unpublish|status|config>`.
- **Monochrome Publish UI & Optional Unified 6-Digit Invite Code (`BOT-556`, `BOT-557`, `a71bc61`, `bot-team-services` `e3099b0`)**: adds a pure achromatic Public Host publishing panel to Desktop `ShareAppDialog` and Mobile Apps, paired with an optional **unified 6-digit numeric PIN gate** synced across published apps (unauthenticated `/` renders a clean monochrome PIN screen and `/api/*` returns `401` until unlocked via an `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` session cookie).
- **Instant L3 Full-Stack Bot App Wake Fix (`#F-647`, `BOT-553`, `21c682e`)**: resolves a state transition edge case where waking L3 backend-powered Bot Apps (such as `codebase-monitor`) could keep the warming strip visible after health readiness settled.

![Public Bot Apps ShareAppDialog, monochrome 6-digit invite-code PIN gate, and live isolated Railway verification](./artifact/apps-public-host-verification.png)

![Mobile L3 codebase-monitor Bot App waking cleanly without a stuck warming strip](./artifact/mobile-codebase-monitor-wake-fixed.png)


## 2. Unified Global `~/.bot-team/` Storage, Dynamic Brand Config & `core.sock` Delegation (`#F-645`, `#F-623` · `BOT-532`, `BOT-550`–`BOT-552`, `BOT-562`)

Keeping high-frequency Feeds and Issues inside git working trees created noisy working-copy diffs during multi-agent sprints. `v1.6.0` unifies operational data under a single user-level home while staying 100% backward-compatible with per-repo state:

- **Global `~/.bot-team/` Default with Seamless `./.bot-team/` Compatibility (`BOT-550`, `BOT-552`, `f6fea6b`)**: migrates and stores workspace Feeds (`~/.bot-team/feeds/<workspace>/feeds.json`) and Issues (`~/.bot-team/issues/<PREFIX>.json`) globally by default while preserving per-project `./.bot-team/` read fallback and explicit per-workspace storage overrides (verified live on `628` Feed posts and `560` `BOT` issues with zero data loss).
- **Dynamic Rename-Ready Brand Config & Settings Switches (`BOT-550`, `BOT-551`, `f6fea6b`, `f36b64c`)**: centralizes product directory names, socket paths, and display tokens into `cli/src/brand-config.ts` (`app/shared/brand-config.ts`), and exposes monochrome **Data Storage Location** switches across Desktop Global Settings, Project Settings, and Mobile System Settings.
- **Freshness-Aware Migration Guard, `issue.*` `core.sock` Delegation & Roster Sync (`BOT-532`, `BOT-562`, `47e9581`, `0dd0ff4`)**: guards storage migration by comparing sequence/mtime freshness so stale local files never overwrite newer global state, delegates CLI `issue.*` mutations cleanly through live `core.sock` for immediate SSE fanout, syncs authoritative issue/board snapshots in `MobileWebServer`, and extends `reconcileRoster` `idleGraceMs` to `30s` (`#F-623`).

![Global, Project, and Mobile System Settings showing unified ~/.bot-team/ and ./.bot-team/ storage controls](./artifact/unified-global-storage-settings.png)


## 3. High-Performance Delta Feeds Engine & Zero-Refresh Real-Time Hardening (`#F-627`, `#F-646`, `#F-626` · `BOT-533`–`BOT-536`, `BOT-558`–`BOT-560`)

In workspaces with hundreds of rich Feed threads, broadcasting full `1.22 MB` snapshots on every comment or status tick wasted bandwidth and risked stale edge caches. `v1.6.0` re-engineers both payload geometry and end-to-end stream liveness:

- **`~1 KB` `FeedSnapshotDelta` SSE & `beforeSeq` Cursor Pagination (`#F-627`, `BOT-534`–`BOT-536`, `c2a1bc2`, `85ae5c7`, `34183c0`, `bot-team-services` `275f6a9`)**: introduces an in-memory Feeds document cache, lean `FeedSnapshotDelta` SSE events (`916 B` new post, `1,191 B` comment, `510 B` delete — a **`>1,000×` payload reduction** vs `1,225 KB` full snapshots), `O(1)` client delta merging, bounded initial page loads (`60` posts on Desktop, `25` on Mobile), and `IntersectionObserver`-driven `beforeSeq` cursor pagination with zero duplicate rows.
- **Zero-Refresh Real-Time Delivery & Severed-Stream Recovery (`#F-646`, `BOT-558`–`BOT-560`, `1b9b5cd`, `35105c7`, `751279d`, `f623464`, `bot-team-services` `3854e0e`, `4b104ff`, `dab1614`)**: adds `15s` named SSE `event: ping` heartbeats, immediate `RelayHub` `warmSnapshots` eviction on live Feeds pushes, `resyncRequired` sequence-gap fallback, clean Phase-2 cache separation, and adaptive filesystem watch — delivering **`5–6 ms` live post updates**, **`8 ms` live comment + status updates**, and **`17–20 ms` automatic catch-up** after severed SSE / mobile background wake without pull-to-refresh.
- **Zero Redundant Pin / Unpin Toasts (`#F-626`, `BOT-533`, `c67ce05`, `bot-team-services` `b544891`)**: removes noisy confirmation toasts when pinning or unpinning Feed posts on Desktop and Mobile since immediate top-of-stream reordering already provides crisp visual feedback.

![Real-time Feeds Playwright E2E verification across Desktop and Mobile with 5-8ms live updates and 17-20ms wake catch-up](./artifact/feeds-realtime-e2e.png)


## 4. Selective Vercel UI SDK Adoption & Safe Inline `sdui` Micro-Cards (`#F-640`, `#F-643` · `BOT-541`–`BOT-547`)

Guided by our ecosystem evaluation (`BOT-541`, `BOT-542`, `64755be`, `f2ad6dc`), `v1.6.0` rejects heavy chat-coupled framework lock-in while selectively adopting three high-leverage rendering and inspection capabilities (`bot-team-services` `e3099b0`):

- **Streaming `remend@^1.4.0` Healer + Fence-Aware Block `React.memo` (`BOT-543`, `8b6e38d`)**: heals unterminated bold, inline code, links, and fences mid-stream before AST parsing and memoizes completed top-level Markdown blocks so active token streaming only re-renders the live tail block (`O(1)` incremental cost) while keeping `graph-canvas` Mermaid diagrams and clickable `.inline-tag` entity chips intact.
- **Zero-Dep Monochrome `StackTraceCard`, Fork `Checkpoint` Ruler & `Confirmation` Polish (`BOT-544`, `d8f90f8`)**: parses Node/V8/browser stack traces into collapsible monochrome cards with clickable workspace file:line links (collapsing internal `node:` / `node_modules` frames by default) and renders `0.5px` bidirectional `[data-fork-checkpoint]` timeline rulers connecting parent and forked child agent sessions.
- **Authoritative 13-Block `BotAppSduiBlock` Schema & Safe Inline ```` ```sdui ```` Micro-Cards (`BOT-545`–`BOT-547`, `625f622`, `de892f8`)**: generates a strict JSON Schema + `apps-lint` validator for all 13 `BotAppSduiBlock` primitives and renders fenced ```` ```sdui ```` blocks directly inside Feed posts, Inbox items, and Journals as crisp monochrome micro-cards (`metrics`, `key-value`, `table`, `steps`, etc.) with a built-in `Card <-> JSON` inspector toggle.

![Inline SDUI micro-card rendered live inside Markdown across Desktop and Mobile viewports](./artifact/vercel-selective-adoption-e2e.png)

![Monochrome inline SDUI Markdown cards with interactive Card and JSON source toggle](./artifact/inline-sdui-markdown-cards.png)


## 5. Native iOS Mobile Transitions, Motion GIF Standard & Bark Push Blueprint (`#F-638`, `#F-651`, `#F-644` · `BOT-537`–`BOT-540`, `BOT-548`, `BOT-549`, `BOT-561`)

Mobile navigation and engineering observability gain tactile native iOS polish and richer visual/notification infrastructure:

- **Native iOS Push/Pop, Sheet Choreography & Zero-Twitch Tabs (`#F-638`, `BOT-537`–`BOT-540`, `6063fe7`, `4c1f0aa`, `5fa13da`, `bot-team-services` `59ff39f`)**: upgrades Mobile CSS curves and interactive edge-swipe gestures so full-screen Bot App runners (`KeepAliveBotAppPool` iframe reuse preserved across push/pop), Repository file sheets, and detail drill-downs animate with `0.35s` iOS spring push/pop + scrim fades, bottom sheets (`Build`, `Collab`, `More`, `Workspace`) enter with `0.36s` iOS sheet-up springs, and top-level tab switches remain `100%` instantaneous (`animationName: none`, `0px` horizontal twitch).
- **End-to-End Animated `.gif` Preservation & Motion-Design Proof Standard (`#F-651`, `BOT-561`, `3aa100c`)**: preserves multi-frame animated `.gif` artifacts intact through `VisualReportsService` and Gallery/Feeds pipelines (bypassing static single-frame flattening) and codifies sequential Playwright frame capture + `.gif` proof reporting for all motion-design work.
- **Bark Native iOS Push Architecture Blueprint (`#F-644`, `BOT-548`, `BOT-549`, `53ab4c5`, `7a47747`)**: establishes the verified Tier-2 `CoreServer` integration blueprint for `$0`-account `AES-256-GCM` end-to-end encrypted iOS push notifications via open-source Bark (`Finb/Bark` + `Finb/bark-server`), including `timeSensitive` Focus breakthrough, 90s desktop active-focus suppression, and cross-device `delete: "1"` lock-screen auto-retraction.

![Mobile Bot Apps full-screen runner with native iOS push/pop transitions and zero-clipping chrome](./artifact/mobile-ios-transitions-apps.png)

## Verification & Architectural Guardrails

- **Three-Tier Runtime Boundary (`ADR 0012` · `#F-111`)**: all 28 `bot-team` commits since `v1.5.0` reside strictly inside Tier-2 (`CoreServer`), Tier-3 (`AppsDaemon` / Public Host deployer), shared/renderer/mobile layers, and `bot-team-services` — keeping the 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` `DAEMON_DIST_FILES` closure byte-for-byte unchanged (`node cli/test/daemon-boundary.mjs` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).
- **Automated Suites & Live Cloud Gates Passed**:
  - **Public Host & Bot Apps v2 (`BOT-557`)**: `apps-public-host` (`6/6`), `apps-daemon-v2` (`33/33`), and live isolated Railway `bot-team-public-apps` E2E verified in both Open mode and 6-digit PIN gate mode (`leakedSensitiveEnv: []`), followed by clean smoke-service teardown (`0` leftover services).
  - **Unified Global Storage (`BOT-552`, `BOT-562`)**: `storage-location-brand` (`8/8`), `issue-sync-resilience` (`5/5`), and live `~/.bot-team/` migration verified across `628` Feed posts and `560` Issues with `0` data loss.
  - **Delta Feeds & Real-Time SSE (`BOT-536`, `BOT-560`)**: `feeds-delta-pagination` (`5/5`), `feeds-realtime-transport` (`7/7`), `feeds-realtime-store` (`5/5`), `cloud-connector` (`10/10`), `core-hot-reload` (`14/14`), and `bot-team-services` `relay-feeds-realtime` (`5/5`), `security-cloud-wave1` (`8/8`), `security-cloud-wave2` (`8/8`), and `cloud-e2e` (`21/21`) — live `cloud-gateway` healthy (`status === "SUCCESS"`, `/api/v1/health` HTTP `200`).
  - **Selective UI Primitives & Code Hygiene (`BOT-547`)**: `streaming-markdown`, `stack-trace-parser`, `sdui-catalog`, `inline-sdui-fence`, `app` + `electron` `tsc --noEmit`, and `pnpm lint:comments` (`0` comments).
- **Editorial Cover & Monochrome Design Rules (`#F-391` · `#C-374-1` · `#F-446` · `#F-199`)**: authored with strictly flat Apple Newsroom `#F5F5F7` cover art (`./artifact/bot-team-v160-release-cover.png` — matte `#F5F5F7` canvas, flat `#FFFFFF` cards with uniform `1px` `#D2D2D7` hairlines, zero neon, zero gradients, zero glow, and zero colored accent stripes).
